title: Yang-Mills Existence and Mass Gap
exact_target: Can every compact simple gauge symmetry produce a rigorously defined four-dimensional Yang--Mills quantum theory with a nonzero energy gap above its vacuum?

sources.citation: Arthur Jaffe and Edward Witten, Quantum Yang-Mills Theory, official Clay problem description.
Towards a Proof of Mass Gap in 3d Yang-Mills Theory — V. P. Nair.
A Constructive Proof of Existence and Mass Gap for Pure SU(3) Yang-Mills in Four-Dimensional Space-Time — D. C. Jacobsen.
